description: This script updates KiCad schematic files (.sch) by replacing component properties with a template-based approach. It processes files in a directory, renames original files, and rewrites them with updated component property lines based on a template read from 'property.sch'.

methods.name: main script logic
methods.description: Performs file processing: reading schematic files, replacing component property lines with template data, and managing file renaming and deletion.
